status: Created before any numerical final-test access. Records two structural contradictions found while executing the locked Phase-8 pre-opening gates, and the human-approved resolution of each.
approved_by: human review, recorded before the sealed final test was numerically opened
resolution_label: Option D - preserve every frozen Phase-7 artifact and every upstream validator; add an append-only Phase-8 provenance layer and relocate Phase-8 outputs into the phase-owned namespace

contradiction_1.reason: The Phase-7 pre-test freeze hashes the Phase-7 tooling registry; therefore mutating that registry in Phase 8 would invalidate historical frozen evidence.
contradiction_1.resolution: Preserve the Phase-7 registry and create an append-only Phase-8 tooling registry referencing it.
contradiction_1.detail: artifacts/phase7_pretest_freeze.json records artifacts/verification_tooling_registry.json inside evidence_sha256 at a1ec2652df1c6c58bce666ccb8c8bda30743ab1209a5aa7469351ca23d79122f. validate_phase7.py re-hashes every evidence path and fails the gate 'All frozen Phase-7 evidence hashes match' on any mismatch. Adding the completed Phase-7 validator to that registry, as the original locked Phase-8 prompt directed, would change its bytes and fail that gate. The freeze itself may not be rewritten: it is the authoritative pre-test record and is hash-gated at 78a0e36080e52941694581eef3280b42f654f00c8865dc306deaac369ccade60.

contradiction_2.reason: Earlier validators do not recognize results/final_test as later-phase-owned and would incorrectly classify legitimate Phase-8 outputs as earlier-phase model results.
contradiction_2.resolution: Store all Phase-8 final-test scientific outputs under the existing phase-owned artifacts/phase8_* namespace rather than modifying frozen upstream validators.
contradiction_2.detail: owned_by_a_later_phase() in validate_foundation.py and validate_phase1.py excludes results/validation and results/models by prefix, and artifacts/phase<N>_ and figures/phase<N>_ by pattern, but not results/final_test. The mandated table names final_model_comparison.csv, metrics_by_horizon.csv, metrics_by_station.csv, metrics_by_station_horizon.csv, severe_metrics.csv and negative_predictions.csv match the forbidden name patterns 'model_comparison', 'metric' and 'prediction', so creating them under results/final_test would fail the gate 'No model-result file exists' in both validators. The alternative fix - adding a prefix to the ownership rule - would modify an upstream validator source and is forbidden.

what_this_amendment_changes: Where Phase-8 evidence is stored, and where the completed Phase-7 validator is registered. Nothing else.

gru_r1_artifact_resolution.why_unambiguous: This is the original Phase-4 selected full model and the only GRU_R1 weight artifact that exists. Phase-7 seeds 43-46 were robustness refits that saved validation prediction arrays only and were never candidates for final-test artifact selection.
gru_r1_artifact_resolution.declared_limitation: The secondary confirmatory role was supported by five-seed robustness evidence, while the frozen evaluable model artifact is the original pre-robustness seed-42 GRU_R1 model.
